process: Verify city, region, latitude and longitude from an authoritative or approved geographic source.
Estimate map position only after at least three reviewed anchors exist.
Render a QA overlay with city/region labels and coordinates.
Require relational geography checks and minimum marker separation.
Require human visual review before changing an anchor from estimated to reviewed.
Never define a QA envelope from an unverified position.
